description: Clinical test definitions (INTERPOLAR). Each entry = one distinct clinical test (component + tier) → one FHIR ValueSet + one Observation profile. 'standard' = the routine value a clinician means; 'specialized' = a clinically distinct variant (free PSA, LDH isoenzymes, WBC differential). The ECL selects the SNOMED-LOINC observables; the ValueSet is emitted LOINC-coded; the Observation profile (FSH, derived from MII KDS Laborbefund) binds the ValueSet to Observation.code and fixes specimen/unit/dataType.
